nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

category_id.description: Category ID, which can further limit the returned category dimensions

category_ids.description: Category ID list filtering; after specifying, return the transaction amount under the corresponding category

currency.description: Currency unit, such as `USD`; maximum length 1000

dateRange.description: Time range, such as `last7Day`, `last30Day`; maximum length 1000

language.description: Return language, such as `zh-CN`, `en-US`; maximum length 1000

pageNumber.description: Page number, value 1-5; out of range returns `errcode 501`

region.description: Region/market code, such as `US`; maximum length 1000

revenue_range.description: Transaction amount / GMV range, left closed and right open

sortField.description: Sorting conditions; when not sorting, pass an empty object `{}`
